name: Panservice
notes:
# Hints
* Our data center (https://datacenter.panservice.it)  sports 400G DWDM channels to IT/Rome/Namex and a national ring that extends to IT/Milan/Mix, IT/Milan/Minap and comes back to Latina.  A third path with a second 400G ring via Frosinone is available.
* We offer a complete software suite for operators with presence in Italy (https://www.olo2olo.it)
* We host an ICANN L-Root replica in our Latina data center
* We host a RIPE-NCC hosted AuthDNS in our Latina data center
* AS20912 uses RPKI validation rejecting invalids
* AS20912 accepts and honors *graceful_shutdown* (RFC-8326) community (65535:0)
* AS20912 offers LAG, BFD, MD5, TTL-security and default-route upon request
